research.title: Exercise form does not always reveal target-muscle recruitment.
research.lead: The first design question was not how to display EMG. It was which signal could show whether the intended muscle was actually active during an exercise.
steps: Candidate A · physiological activity through surface EMG
Candidate B · angular displacement through visible contraction
Decision · select EMG after subtle contraction proved unreliable to observe geometrically
research.reverseCopy: 3-second individual calibration → filtering → squared signal → Kalman filtering → four relative-intensity bands → sample counts → session percentages.
research.note: The current result is a distribution of recorded samples across four relative EMG bands—an approximation of time distribution under stable sampling, not an automated coaching recommendation.

margin.title: Can principle agreement help explain why one case feels relevant to another?
margin.lead: The current analysis approaches that broader question through a smaller test: whether the frequency of a principle predicts agreement with it.
steps: Broader question · principle patterns and perceived relevance
Current test · principle frequency and agreement
Current result · no relationship detected for the principles examined
Next direction · return to similarity and relevance at the case level
margin.reverseTitle: The broader question is still open.
margin.reverseCopy: The current result narrows one hypothesis, but it does not yet explain perceived relevance between cases.
margin.note: Keep preliminary findings proportional to the evidence.

diagram.title: Residual probability changed the allocation.
diagram.lead: After preferred courses reached capacity, some students still had unassigned probability. The remaining allocation rule could push them unnecessarily toward lower-ranked courses.
steps: Version 1 · distribute residual probability through random course choices
Version 2 · balance remaining student demand with remaining course capacity
diagram.reverseCopy: Version 2 changed how the remaining probability was distributed. The revision was designed to produce a more balanced fractional matrix, but it still required separate evaluation for fairness and satisfaction.
diagram.note: A cleaner residual rule is an algorithmic improvement, not proof of a fair outcome.
